A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same S2AM3D research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables and supplementary material on PDF pages 11-13. Full-text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the content matches apart from the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original segmentation experiments and ablations in Section 5, plus density, complexity, scale-sensitivity and failure analyses in the supplement.

after.justification: v3 retains the original segmentation experiments, ablations and supplementary analyses, including quantitative results and qualitative predictions.

M1.justification: The point-consistent encoder, scale-aware decoder, contrastive and segmentation objectives, two-stage training, data-curation procedure and supplementary full-segmentation post-processing algorithm are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the curated Objaverse-derived dataset and PartNet for training, and PartObjaverse-Tiny and PartNet-E for interactive and full-segmentation evaluation. Supplementary test scenarios and qualitative-example coverage are unchanged.

E2.justification: Interactive comparisons retain Point-SAM and P3-SAM. Full-segmentation comparisons retain Find3D, SAMPart3D, SAMesh, PartField and P3-SAM. The supplementary complexity comparison also has identical membership.

E3.justification: Training budgets, data filtering and splits, input configurations, IoU computation and prompt selection match. Both retain evaluation on 10,000 normalized points, ground-truth scale prompts, simulated interactive full segmentation and the same supplementary testing procedures.

E4.justification: Section 5.3 retains identical ablations of 3D supervision, curated training data and scale embeddings. Supplementary Sections 2.1-2.4 retain the same density, complexity, scale-perturbation and failure analyses.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, error bars or significance tests. Statistical and uncertainty reporting is unchanged throughout the main text and supplement.

E6.justification: All numerical entries and qualitative findings match. For example, Table 1 retains scale-conditioned IoUs of 61.19 and 77.51, and Table 2 retains full-segmentation scores of 63.29 and 77.98 on PartObjaverse-Tiny and PartNet-E, respectively. Supplementary results are also identical.

T1.justification: The contrastive formulation, scale definition, Equations (1)-(10) and supplementary post-processing equations are identical. No mathematical assumption, derivation, theorem or proof is added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about globally consistent features, continuous granularity control, the curated dataset and segmentation performance. The stated contributions are unchanged.

C2.justification: Interpretations of feature consistency, scale conditioning and dataset benefits match. Both retain the same qualifications concerning ground-truth scale evaluation and failures on thin structures or geometrically similar parts requiring color cues.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 and supplementary Section 1 provide identical hyperparameters, hardware, training durations, initialization, filtering and post-processing details. The project-page link is unchanged; the arXiv stamp's version-link update supplies no new reproducibility information.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion, comparisons with previous approaches and cited works are identical, including both the main and supplementary reference lists.

P1.justification: The first-page arXiv stamp changes from v2 dated 8 Mar 2026 to v3 dated 16 Apr 2026. All paper prose, headings, terminology and section organization remain identical.

P2.justification: All main and supplementary figures, tables, captions and the algorithm retain identical content, styling and placement. Rendered pages match outside the first-page version/date stamp; no figure, table or page-layout revision is present.

improvement.justification: The scientific text, methods, experiments, results, limitations and supplementary material are identical. Updating the arXiv version/date stamp and its corresponding link does not meaningfully improve or diminish the paper's quality.
